options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

--help.help: show this help message and exit

-aesKey.help: AES key to use for Kerberos Authentication (128 or 256 bits)

-append.help: Appends keys to file specified with -outputfile

-blob.help: Blob base64 encoded or in file

-bypass-shared-violation.help: Will try to bypass Shared Violation Error with a silly esentutl trick

-dc-ip.help: IP Address of the domain controller. If omitted it will use the domain part (FQDN) specified in the target parameter

-dump-all.help: Dump also certificates not used for client authentication

-dump-offline-users.help: Will try to offline users by dumping them NTUSER.DAT file. Noisy

-export-browser.help: Dump looted Browser data blobs to specified directory, regardless they were decrypted

-export-certificates.help: Dump looted certificates to specified directory, regardless they were decrypted

-export-cm.help: Dump looted Credential Manager blob to specified directory, regardless they were decrypted

-export-dir.help: Dump looted files to specified directory, regardless they were decrypted

-export-mk.help: Dump looted masterkey files to specified directory, regardless they were decrypted

-export-rdg.help: Dump looted RDGMan.settings blob to specified directory, regardless they were decrypted

-export-sccm.help: Dump looted SCCM secrets to specified directory

-export-triage.help: Dump looted blob to specified directory, regardless they were decrypted

-export-vpol.help: Dump looted Vaults blob to specified directory, regardless they were decrypted

-export-wifi.help: Dump looted Wifi Profile xml files to specified directory, regardless they were decrypted

-hashes-outputfile.help: Export hashes of masterkeys to file in Hashcat/JtR format

-kdcHost.help: FQDN of the domain controller. If omitted it will use the domain part (FQDN) specified in the target parameter

-kill-browser.help: Will try to kill browser's process. Usefull when Shared Violation Error

-nthashes.help: File containing username:nthash that will be used eventually to decrypt masterkeys

-outputfile.help: Export keys to specific filename (default key.pvk)

-passwords.help: File containing username:password that will be used eventually to decrypt masterkeys

-pvk.help: Pvk file with domain backup key

-root.help: Root directory (for local operations). This directory should contain Windows and Users subdirectories

-target.help: Target ip or address, or LOCAL

-use-kcache.help: Use Kerberos authentication from ccache file (KRB5CCNAME)

-v20support.help: Will dump v20 chromium credentials (will perform a LSA dump in form of reg save)

-wmi.help: Dump SCCM secrets from WMI requests results
